title: Associated primes of a Cohen–Macaulay local ring are minimal primes
statement: Let $(T,\mathfrak n)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] (a Noetherian commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal $\mathfrak n$) of Krull dimension $e=\dim T$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] (finite, as $T$ is Noetherian local), and assume that $T$ is Cohen–Macaulay in the sense that $\operatorname{depth}(T)\ge e$ [def-weil-pbc-depth], that is, $\mathfrak n$ contains a $T$-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence] of length $e$. Let $\mathfrak p\subset T$ be a prime ideal for which there is $z\in T$ with $\operatorname{Ann}_T(z)=\{a\in T: az=0\}=\mathfrak p$ (an associated prime of $T$). Then $\mathfrak p$ is a minimal prime ideal of $T$ (no prime ideal of $T$ is strictly contained in $\mathfrak p$).
